formulas.window: Exactly the last 300 completed, contiguous US equity sessions ending at reference_close; fewer bars rejected.
formulas.price_basis: Archived raw OHLCV, no dividend adjustment, no rounding or silent repair of input values.
formulas.atr: ATR14 Wilder: TR[i]=max(H[i]-L[i],abs(H[i]-C[i-1]),abs(L[i]-C[i-1])) for i>=1. Seed=mean(first 14 TR); thereafter ATR=(13*previous+TR)/14.
formulas.rsi: RSI14 Wilder: gains=max(deltaClose,0), losses=max(-deltaClose,0). Seed=mean(first 14 changes); Wilder recurrence thereafter. RSI=100-100/(1+avgGain/avgLoss); zero loss=>100, both zero=>50.
formulas.ema: EMA20/50/200: first archived close is the seed; alpha=2/(period+1); recurse over all 300 closes. This is a declared finite-window initialization, not a claim of server initialization parity.
formulas.macd: MACD=EMA12(close)-EMA26(close), both seeded at first close. Signal=EMA9 of the complete MACD series, seeded at its first value (0).
formulas.adv20_usd: Arithmetic mean of close*volume over last 20 sessions, including reference close; US USD listing contract required.
formulas.consolidation_bars: Count among 15 sessions immediately preceding reference close whose high-low range is strictly below 1.5*final ATR14; identical to build-scan.js fallback.
formulas.rounding_anomalies: OHLC bounds exceeded by <=0.001 absolute price units may be diagnosed and retained unchanged, matching the documented upstream rounding policy. Larger anomalies, inverted high/low, nonpositive prices or negative volumes reject.
formulas.server_comparison: Diagnostic deltas only. Undated/current server technicals cannot certify the derived as_of; the completed bar window does.

server_comparison.note: No server parity or timestamp certification is inferred. Derived date is certified from input bars.
